operator.name: Vision Outreach Media
operator.voice: Mission-driven, plain-spoken, trust-first, and (for the church niche) faith-friendly. Never hype, never jargon. Speak like a helpful expert, not a salesperson. Deliverables say "Vision Outreach Media (VOM)" or "the operator" — never a personal name.

platform.label: WordPress
platform.hosting: one.com managed WordPress (VOM's own apex); client WordPress sites are hosted per-client and DNS-pointed from the delegated clients zone
platform.headline: WordPress — the owner keeps control of content without a developer.

web_presence.title: Public web presence
web_presence.implementation: WordPress site (block theme) — home, offer, about, contact

crm.title: CRM — contacts, pipeline, running inventory
crm.implementation: Operator-side CRM (not in WordPress); site forms feed it

finance_admin.title: Finance & admin (invoicing, VAT, bookkeeping)
finance_admin.implementation: NL bookkeeping tool + Stripe payouts reconciled monthly

analytics_reporting.title: Analytics & presence reporting
analytics_reporting.implementation: Engage AI plugin reports real page/post counts as ground truth

email_marketing.title: Email list & broadcasts
email_marketing.implementation: Brevo list + form plugin; broadcasts sent from Brevo

social_publishing.title: Social content production & scheduling
social_publishing.implementation: Engage AI Content Studio inside wp-admin (owner-operable)

documents_contracts.title: Quotes, proposals & contracts
documents_contracts.implementation: Template pack + e-sign SaaS, tracked on the CRM record

booking.title: Appointment booking / scheduling
booking.implementation: Booking plugin, or embed the operator's scheduling SaaS

checkout_payments.title: Checkout & payments
checkout_payments.implementation: Stripe checkout (hosted) linked from Woo/pages; iDEAL enabled for NL

content_publishing.title: Content publishing (blog / news / articles)
content_publishing.implementation: WordPress posts + categories; owner edits without a developer

support_inbox.title: Support inbox & FAQ
support_inbox.implementation: Shared mailbox + FAQ pages; replies drafted, human-approved

product_catalog.title: Product catalog (what is for sale, at what price)
product_catalog.implementation: WooCommerce products/variations; Stripe as the gateway

membership_access.title: Member area & access control
membership_access.implementation: Membership plugin gating pages by plan; login lives on the client's site

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions / recurring billing
subscriptions.implementation: Stripe Billing (portal hosted by Stripe), membership plugin for access

forge_authorization.scope: unattended forge build + deploy to 'vercel' for this business, limited to: composing the platform modules, writing the public site, wiring rails that already have credentials, publishing the result, and — for a hosting target that gates new projects behind a login — making that one deployment publicly reachable. Does not authorize sending email, charging anyone, or posting to any channel.
